name: Shuudan Chikan Densha -Hassha All Right!-
original_name: 集団痴漢電車-発射オーライ！-
source:
Main character gets into incident on the train and barely escapes conviction. After the court he is approached by the legend of molesters, genius of past. Protagonist infuses with enthusiasm upon learning these astonishing techniques from him.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-april-2006-tenshitsuki-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角在火车上遭遇意外，险些逃脱定罪。法庭结束后，他被传说中的性骚扰者、过去的天才所接近。主角在向他学习这些惊人的技巧后充满了热情。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-april-2006-tenshitsuki-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
